newsitem.title: USA: Majestic Star owner to seek Detroit casino license.
newsitem.headline: Majestic Star owner to seek Detroit casino license.

text.p: Detroit businessman Don Barden announced Tuesday he will seek one of three casino licenses to be awarded by the city to build a $500 million casino and entertainment center downtown.
Barden, owner and operator of the Majestic Star Casino in Gary, Ind., said he would locate his casino on 75 acres of land he controls with a monorail connection to the Cobo Convention Center.
Barden will ask the Detroit planning commission to designate an area including his land as a gaming enterprise district during their meeting Thursday, he said in a statement.
In November, Detroit voters approved the building of three casinos to help revitalize downtown. Winners of those licenses are expected to be announced by the end of the year.
Circus Circus Enterprises Inc announced last week that it had joined a local group in a bid for a casino license. MGM Grand Inc previously unveiled a $400 million casino-hotel proposal.
Other interested parties include a local group called Greektown Casino LLC and gambling heavyweights Mirage Resorts Inc Inc and Harrah's Entertainment Inc.
